anti_overlap: Cost of mk's adjudication attention, card-queue sizing, and gated-vs-streaming sequencing of Phase F — another reviewer owns resource allocation and sequencing.
Implementation mechanics: file formats, networkx usage, script structure, or how adjudication cards are rendered.
Product framing, eval consumer needs, or model-capability rankings drawn from the 28-model sweep.
decision_lens: For every claimed piece of evidence, ask whether the agreement could have arisen from shared inheritance rather than independent access to the truth. If it could, it grades as no evidence at all, no matter how many witnesses show it. Weight only judgments a correlated pair would be unlikely to make together by disposition alone.
distance_rationale: Philology reconstructs a lost original from corrupt copies using rules developed over four centuries in a domain with no computation, no statistics, and no notion of a model. Its core apparatus — eliminatio codicum descriptorum, contamination, conjunctive versus separative error — is a fully worked theory of when agreement between sources is evidence and when it is an artifact of common descent. Nothing in graph engineering, ML evaluation, or data quality carries that theory, so it supplies constraints the plan's own vocabulary cannot express.
expected_isomorphisms: Manuscript witnesses map to the two rating model families; contamination maps to shared pretraining and prompt framing that make agreement non-evidential; codices descripti (copies eliminated before counting) maps to near-duplicate lens merging and to counting correlated raters as one; the archetype maps to the single newsletter corpus plus the single 2026-03-25 generation batch from which all lenses and edges descend; conjunctive versus separative errors map to distinguishing evidence that two lenses are the same from evidence that they are distinct; significant versus trivial variants map to chance-corrected versus raw agreement; a stemma built on an unrevised collation maps to recomputing communities and bridge scores over an unvalidated graph; the critical apparatus versus the constituted text maps to the 4-type edge taxonomy versus what the eval actually consumes.
focus: Whether the plan's evidence structure can distinguish independent corroboration from shared inheritance — in the two raters, in the near-duplicate lenses, and in the single-batch edge corpus itself
name: fd-stemmatics-witness-independence
persona: Apply the perspective of a textual critic reconstructing a lost archetype from surviving manuscript witnesses — a discipline whose central rule is that agreement proves nothing until independence is proven. Copies made from other copies are eliminated before they are counted; contaminated witnesses inflate false consensus; only errors unlikely to recur by chance carry stemmatic weight. A stemma built on an unrevised collation depicts the collator's habits, not the tradition.
review_areas: Rater independence: are the two model families separate witnesses or correlated copies? Does the plan measure pretraining and prompt-induced correlation before converting agreement into confidence?
The archetype problem: 291 lenses from one corpus, 1,779 edges from one 2026-03-25 single-model batch — is validation independent of generation, or a copy checking its own exemplar?
Significant vs trivial agreement: 'does a contrast exist?' may be near-always-yes. Are base rates, chance-corrected agreement, and planted negatives reported anywhere in the design?
Codices descripti: does embedding similarity separate true near-duplicates from merely adjacent lenses, and what happens to a merged node's inherited share of the 1,779 edges?
Transfer diagnosis: was the prior dual-rater item-labeling failure caused by task difficulty or by these witnesses? Only the first diagnosis licenses the edge-validation bet.
Apparatus vs fact: are the 4 edge types claims about the world or editorial convenience, and does the eval need more than one significant relation ('confusable, and why')?

severity_examples.condition: Both families agree on the large majority of contrasts edges by shared disposition, so the replacement confidence field reproduces exactly the decorative-confidence pathology the audit condemned, now carrying a stronger claim to being trustworthy
severity_examples.scenario: Two-rater agreement is converted straight into calibrated confidence with no independence check and no chance correction

severity_examples.condition: A filler edge written to satisfy the degree-6 quota is re-confirmed because both raters are reading the generator's own justification rather than judging the lens pair cold
severity_examples.scenario: Edges are validated by the same model population that generated them, with the original rationale supplied as context

severity_examples.condition: The trust cluster merges three lenses and the union of their edges silently becomes new, never-validated assertions attached to the surviving node
severity_examples.scenario: Node merges land before edge validation with no stated reconciliation rule for inherited edges

source_domain: Textual criticism and stemmatics — Lachmannian recension of manuscript traditions
success_hints: Name the missing measurement, not the missing conclusion: the statistic whose absence makes a bet unfalsifiable (chance-corrected agreement, per-rater positive rate, planted-negative control).
Propose the cheap collation first: a 30-50 edge pilot seeded with planted fake contrasts edges costs about an hour and settles the dual-rater bet before any of the 414 are touched.
Separate 'the method failed' from 'these witnesses failed' whenever the plan cites the prior dual-rater item-labeling failure.
Trace one concrete case from the plan (trust cluster, 41 conflicting pairs, 26 no-edge eval pairs) end-to-end through the pipeline and state what actually happens to it.
Rank by permanence: a bad merge is irreversible, a bad confidence score is not.
task_context: Stress the plan's central bets before mk ratifies it as a /goal: (1) that dual-rater edge validation will work where dual-rater item labeling already failed in this exact domain; (2) that graph-quality-first beats streaming/incremental restart of eval item generation; (3) that mk's adjudication attention (the scarcest resource) is spent on the right units — edges vs node merges vs generated items; (4) that the 4-type edge taxonomy is the right substrate for a discrimination eval at all. Surface missed alternatives and any cheaper falsification tests that should run before the full overhaul. A wrong call here wastes weeks of graph work and mk's labeling budget. The object of review is the proposed plan document: its Phases A-F, its Constraints and doctrine section, and its Known open questions.
